participation.context: Sat in his pew in a white ruff, ten yards off, and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

participation.context: Told you to count without a voice, and told Alse she was inside the precept.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.quote: A precept from Crosby Place, to be read upon this Sunday.

story.body: You heard the precept against blue starch. You counted the glass, the pews, and the Mayor's neck. He did not speak. Alse's band was white. A woman in the north aisle was blue at the band and looked at the roof.

relations.note: the curate reads the Mayor's precept in his hearing
relations.quote: A precept from Crosby Place, to be read upon this Sunday.

title: Heard the precept against blue starch

participation.context: Said fourteen parts, and said the question was not his to decide.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Reached fourteenthly, closed the sermon, and sent them to dinner.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Called it sound doctrine, and moved the question off the porch.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked who decides where a permitted shade ends and an offence begins.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: she calls his sermon sound doctrine

story.body: You heard fourteenthly. You said fourteen parts of it. Mistress Ansell said you had heard a sermon to the end. Alse asked who decides where a permitted shade ends. You said not you. Nobody drew the edge for her.

relations.note: she calls his sermon sound doctrine

title: Heard fourteenthly, and Alse's question at the door

participation.context: Spoke the three sentences and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the city was hungry and its magistrate was at war with a colour. You said to keep it for a constable. Then you stopped.
